skill.name: generating-ugc-videos
skill.description: Creates product-focused UGC videos with an on-camera creator, including reviews, unboxings, try-ons, and tutorials.
skill.summary: Plans, scripts, storyboards, renders, and stitches creator-led product videos.
skill.author: supercmohq

security_audit.summary: All 37 static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code spans and ordinary prose, with no shell execution or reconnaissance present. Semantic review found unsafe retry guidance, missing consent checks for real-person images, and no disclosure requirement for synthetic endorsements.

remediation.issue: The workflow recommends retrying refused content and switching models after repeated refusals.
remediation.suggestion: Stop after a safety refusal, explain the restriction, and require a compliant revised request before any new generation.

remediation.issue: A supplied person photo can become the creator identity without explicit authorization.
remediation.suggestion: Require confirmation that the user owns the image or has consent for synthetic video use before processing it.

remediation.issue: Generated reviews and testimonials lack a disclosure requirement.
remediation.suggestion: Require clear disclosure that the creator and endorsement are AI-generated and prohibit unsupported personal-experience claims.

semantic_findings.title: Safety Refusal Circumvention Guidance
semantic_findings.description: The workflow directs regeneration after an unsafe refusal and recommends switching the clip model after another refusal. Repeated retries can bypass provider safeguards instead of resolving the prohibited content.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions explicitly prescribe retries after safety refusals and a model switch after repeated refusal.

semantic_findings.description: A supplied photo can become the identity reference for synthetic video without verifying ownership or the depicted person's consent.

content.value_statement: Producing consistent UGC videos requires coordinated scripts, actors, storyboards, and clips. This skill manages that workflow from product input through a stitched video.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes supplied product and creator images before planning.
Routes requests to review, unboxing, try-on, or tutorial workflows.
Builds clip plans from the requested duration.
Creates scripts, creator references, storyboards, and video prompts.
Generates multiple clips concurrently and polls pending jobs.
Stitches completed clips into one video with hard cuts.
limitations: Requires a product image or accessible product URL.
Only supports videos that show a person with a product.
Depends on separate analysis, actor, storyboard, script, and video tools.
Generated motion, speech, product details, and text may contain visual errors.

use_cases.title: Launch a Product Review
use_cases.description: Create a short creator-led review that demonstrates supplied product claims.

use_cases.title: Produce an Unboxing Video
use_cases.description: Turn product and package photos into a structured opening sequence.

use_cases.title: Build a Product Tutorial
use_cases.description: Show product use through ordered steps across one or more clips.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 15-second vertical review using this product image. Use only the claims I provide and show the concept before generation.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner has one product image and needs a short review.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an Unboxing
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 30-second vertical unboxing from these product and package photos. Keep the package and product appearance consistent across clips.
prompt_templates.scenario: A seller needs a two-clip package opening.

prompt_templates.title: Direct a Try-On
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 45-second try-on using the supplied product and authorized creator photos. Include fit observations, three angles, and only verified claims.
prompt_templates.scenario: A fashion team has approved visual references and detailed direction.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-Clip Tutorial
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 60-second product tutorial in 9:16. Use the supplied steps, preserve exact product anchors, allocate actions by clip, and request approval before rendering.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced producer needs a controlled four-clip workflow.

output_examples.input: Create a 15-second review for this travel bottle using the claim that it keeps drinks cold for 12 hours.
output_examples.output: Concept: A commuter tests the bottle after a workday, shows the remaining ice, and gives a concise verdict. One vertical clip uses the supplied claim.

output_examples.input: Make a 30-second unboxing from these package and product photos.
output: Clip 1: The creator opens the supplied package and reveals the product.
Clip 2: The creator shows verified product details and gives a brief first impression.

output_examples.input: Create a 45-second tutorial showing the three supplied setup steps.
output_examples.output: A three-clip plan assigns one verified setup step to each clip, preserves the product description, and ends after the completed result.

best_practices: Provide clear product images, verified claims, desired duration, and delivery ratio.
Confirm authorization before using any real person's image as a creator reference.
Review and approve the concept and script before starting billed generation.
anti_patterns: Do not request unsupported product claims or fictional personal experiences.
Do not use a real person's image without permission for synthetic video creation.
Do not retry or switch models to evade a safety refusal.

faq.question: What videos can this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates creator-led product reviews, unboxings, try-ons, and tutorials.

faq.question: What input should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a product image or URL, duration, format, verified claims, and any authorized creator or package images.

faq.question: Can it create videos without a person?
faq.answer: No. This workflow requires an on-camera person interacting with a product.

faq.question: Does it generate the full video?
faq.answer: Yes, when the required connected tools are available. It plans, renders, monitors, and stitches the clips.

faq.question: Will it invent product claims?
faq.answer: No. The workflow directs scripts to use only claims supplied by the user.

faq.question: Can I use a photo of a real person?
faq.answer: Only when you own the image or have explicit permission for synthetic video use.
